notes: 「工作区显示」卡片默认再折叠两类干扰条目：① 空会话（建了从没发过消息、也没跑过 turn 的历史条目）；② Mnemon 空闲审查的父容器（mnemon-review-owner-v1-*，它自己只有一条 subagent/catalog，内容都在子会话里）。本机默认视图从 99 条降到 10 条。卡片标题行新增「显示空会话」勾选项，需要时可以放回来；footer 会说明折叠了多少条空会话与多少条智能体会话。
notesEn: The "Workspace visibility" card now collapses two more kinds of noise by default: (1) blank sessions (created but never used — no message, no turn); (2) Mnemon idle-review parents (mnemon-review-owner-v1-*, which only carry a subagent/catalog event — the actual content lives in the child session). On this machine the default view drops from 99 entries to 10. A "Show blank" checkbox in the card header brings them back, and the footer reports how many blank and agent sessions were collapsed.
